title: Refusing an Unfair Business Shortcut
paragraphs: A supplier offers Dian a lower price for materials. In return, the supplier asks Dian to put false information in a quality report.
The lower price could help Dian's small company. He thinks that no one may find the false information in the long report.
Dian says no. He explains that his company needs honest reports. Its good name matters more than a quick saving.
Months later, people find false reports from another company. That company loses trust. Dian is grateful that he chose honesty.
